# Sadath Company

> Web design studio building beautiful, fast websites for startups — design, build, hosting, and e-commerce, plus strategic consulting.

The Sadath Company Ltd is a UK-registered web design and development studio (England & Wales, Company No. 16707212). We work with founders to design, build, and launch websites and online stores, with flat-fee packages and custom Statements of Work per client.
